summary: Build fleet KPIs, route optimisation, and replacement analysis skills in 5 days. Train with practical tools and templates.
lede: Fleet management training helps vehicle and transport professionals measure fleet performance and plan asset use, maintenance and routing. It covers fleet utilisation, total cost of ownership, telematics and KPI dashboards, with practical work on maintenance planning, vehicle replacement priorities and route optimisation; learners also develop fleet reports and safety checklists to support decisions on cost, availability and service reliability.
audienceIntro: This advanced fleet management and optimisation course is built for you if you already handle vehicles, routing, maintenance, or transport performance and now need sharper control over cost, uptime, and service reliability.
prerequisites: Participants should already work in fleet, transport, logistics, workshop, or operations roles and bring working knowledge of vehicle schedules, maintenance logs, fuel records, and service performance reports. An intermediate grasp of Excel or a comparable spreadsheet tool is recommended because several exercises use fleet KPI calculations, whole life costing, and replacement analysis. No programming is required, but you should be ready to work with telematics reports, operating dashboards, and sample maintenance datasets during the course. Advanced topics are taught at operational and applied implementation level, not as engineering design.
